3.comment: 【内容边界·选段】年龄保护与特征提取格式
3.content: required/preferred facets: hair_color, hair_length, hair_style, eye_color, bust, height, age_group, skin, build, species, ears. height: short|average|tall, only when explicitly stated. age_group: child|young|mature; exact stated age stays in age. Child and teen illustrations must remain neutral, fully clothed and omit breast-size tags. Values must be arrays. Colors: black, white, blonde, red, brown, blue, green, purple, pink, grey, aqua. Hair length: short, medium, long, very long. Only explicitly stated appearance is required; inferred rendering preferences are preferred. Missing facts are omitted. Personality is not a canonical character database fact. Bust-size traits describe adults only.
